verdict.rationale: Sandbox or test environments are a fair question for a SaaS with an MCP server, CLI and API, but the evidence pack never documents a sandbox, test workspace or isolated environment that keeps users away from production data. The local CLI review is a different feature (pre-push review), not an isolated test environment, so it earns no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can test against a sandbox environment without touching production data
